title: Retire the remaining v1 vertical vocabulary and harden the document gate
summary: The document alignment left two kept documents teaching retired v1 vertical and result vocabulary: docs/operator-release-gate-v1.md still listed canonical-result.json in the acceptance bundle and used concrete ass-spec/spec.md examples, and docs/multi-window-run-isolation-and-host-lifecycle-design.md still said frontend/Spec/canonical-result. A compiled Run emits platform-ledger.json, platform-events.jsonl, platform-run.log, platform-observability.*, and platform-performance-bill.*, and a terminal review atom is one of satisfied, violated, not_applicable, unknown, or blocked; canonical-result.json is not produced. This change makes operator-release-gate-v1.md domain-neutral, makes the multi-window design domain-neutral, adds operator-release-gate-v1.md to NORMATIVE_DOCUMENTS so it cannot regress, removes the superseded capability-provider-contract-v1.md from that set, and repoints the superseded host-agent-protocol.md banner at the v2 authority instead of the retired llm-agent-orchestration.md. Follow-up note: the earlier align-readme-and-retire-legacy-vertical-docs.json acceptance claimed check_english_text.py stays green; that script is in fact rc=1 with 1788 lines identical to origin/main, so the red is pre-existing and not introduced by that change. Implementation evidence: this change landed in c5b80d3, the commit that added this record, and remains in force at 66e7e45; Verification run 35193534602 on that landing commit concluded failure (Fast and Full red, Install matrix green) and Fast and Full were repaired by later commits, so the record is carried as implemented rather than verified.

platform: The platform owns the document boundary gate and the normative document set
plugin: No plugin runtime change; plugin-facing documentation only

forbiddenResponsibilities: The gate must not forbid a term that is still current platform vocabulary
No document may be exempted from the gate to make it pass
The change must not alter the emitted Run artifact set or the terminal result vocabulary
acceptance: docs/operator-release-gate-v1.md lists the emitted platform views (platform-observability.json, platform-performance-bill.json) and no canonical-result.json
docs/operator-release-gate-v1.md and docs/multi-window-run-isolation-and-host-lifecycle-design.md carry no forbidden domain or retired result term
docs/operator-release-gate-v1.md is in NORMATIVE_DOCUMENTS and the boundary check passes
the superseded docs/capability-provider-contract-v1.md is no longer in NORMATIVE_DOCUMENTS
docs/host-agent-protocol.md no longer names the retired llm-agent-orchestration.md as the authoritative runtime model
scripts/check_document_boundaries.py returns 0 and scripts/run_tests.py fast and full stay green
